credits: Alesis: the Quadraverb (1989) and its factory programs, which a development build compiles from the owner's own ROM image on the developer's computer; no Alesis program is in this repository
repeat98: the reverse engineering of the Quadraverb's DSP, the integer model and the compiled engine

presentation.label: DEV BUILD
presentation.summary: Development build for measuring the compiled Quadraverb engine on a unit: one factory program, a MIX knob. Not a release.
presentation.overview: One Quadraverb factory program compiled to straight-line DSP code, run at 44.1 kHz on its own FX2 ring, bit-exact against the integer model in the emulator. Built on the developer's computer from their own ROM image and never published.
highlights: One program built in, named in the effect's name (QV DEV 5, QV DEV 40)
MIX on knob F: 0 dry, 127 wet only
usage: Try the package from engine/qvunit.py build on a unit (TESTING.md), pick QV DEV on an audio track's FX2, turn F (MIX).

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: dry/wet: 0 the dry alone, 127 the wet alone

limitations: Development build: one factory program per package, no program choice, MIX only. Never published.
FX2 only: each instance uses the first 15,870 words of its track's 16K-word FX2 buffer (Midiverb's layout), leaving Sidechain Compressor's key window.
A new instance is silent (dry at its mix) for its first 7 to 13 calls while its ring clears, 1,024 words a call: under 5 ms.

Unlike the original: 44.1 kHz instead of about 42 kHz (delays and sweeps about 5 % shorter and faster), a mono input from the average of left and right, and 24-bit words; not compared with a real Quadraverb.

storage.label: DSP program / state
storage.conditions: The generated engine for one program: its code and the tables its init writes (about 900 P words), the r7 block $00-$83, and up to 15,870 words of the track's FX2 buffer in Y (the ring, its distance table and 32 dry words). See TESTING.md.

processing.label: DSP cycles
processing.conditions: interlock_scan's stall model on the traced proc in dsp_host, one instance, 16-frame blocks (engine/verify_unit.py --cycles): 5 STEREO FLANGE 214.7 on average and 221.6 in the dearest block, 40 167 ms DELAY and 56 SKANK GUITAR 240.6. A model, not a measurement on a unit.

cpuPrice.conditions: Provisional, not measured: a DSP-only effect with no ColdFire code, so its frame-interrupt share is expected near Midiverb's (1.1 with ColdFire code). To be measured on the unit with npm run device:price (TESTING.md).

tests.summary: Development build. engine/verify_unit.py: bit-exact against the integer model in dsp_host for programs 5, 40 and 56 (MIX values, splits, a dirty Y, two instances, a stale state, the guard). Not run on a unit.
gates: Worst-case cycles under parameter modulation and maximum load
Exact memory region and maximum-instance totals
Owner-reviewed real-hardware evidence with actual coverage and limitations

license.declaration: The draft's own code and documentation are MIT (LICENSE). The Alesis Quadraverb programs are not in this repository: engine/qvunit.py compiles one from the developer's own ROM image into gen/ (ignored by Git) and ~/.cache, and the package built from it stays on the developer's computer. No Elektron firmware, routines or tables are included.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: QV DEV <program> in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to QV DEV <program> and press YES.
Press FX2 for the main page: MIX on knob F.
